changelog:
jedToolKit 26.4 introduces flexible update channels, persistent release preferences, and enhanced update status reporting.

Software Update Tracks: Seamlessly toggle between Stable and Legacy release channels using a new control in the table header. Your preference is automatically saved and dynamically adjusts remote update checks.

Context-Aware Reporting: Update cards and up-to-date status views now explicitly report which release channel is actively providing updates.

This update includes stability improvements and background fixes, and is recommended for all users.
